_help.label: text shown in the menu (required)
_help.path: path to a .bat / .cmd / .exe / any command (required). Absolute, or relative to the app folder. Supports %ENV_VARS% and ~
_help.mode: 'console' (visible window, default) or 'hidden' (no window). Both are stoppable from the Running submenu.
_help.cwd: optional working directory (defaults to the folder of 'path')
_help.admin: optional true = launch elevated (UAC prompt). Note: elevated tasks cannot be stopped from the menu.
_help.separator: use { "separator": true } to draw a divider line
